goals.objective: Rank 389 discovered resources — convert to opportunities for deployment
goals.description:
Resource-miner completed parallel discovery cycles on humanaios-ui/humanaios (16 resources) and humanaios-ui/operations (373 resources). Aggregator now ranks by ROI, strategic fit, feasibility to produce 15-25 ranked opportunities for local-machine-optimizer to implement.

## Input
- 389 resources discovered + verified with source verification discipline
- 9 findings logged (6 findings + 2 unknowns + 1 decision, all sourced)
- Miner findings: emailService/tokenService utilities, 79 deployment files, 35 CI/CD workflows, 258 automation scripts

## Success Criteria
✅ 15-25 opportunities ranked and proposed
✅ Each opportunity has ROI calculation + implementation steps
✅ Risk/dependency analysis included
✅ Proposal sent to local-machine-optimizer with full context
✅ Decision logged as artifact (sourced_from miner findings)

## ROI Scoring Formula
ROI_SCORE = (IMPACT × FEASIBILITY × STRATEGIC_FIT) / IMPLEMENTATION_COST

Where:
- IMPACT (0-1): value if deployed (latency, automation, code reuse, observability)
- FEASIBILITY (0-1): implementation difficulty (dependencies, barriers, constraints)
- STRATEGIC_FIT (0-1): alignment with system goals (performance, reliability, cost)
- IMPLEMENTATION_COST (tokens): estimated effort

## Timeline
- Analysis phase: Immediate
- Ranking phase: Next 2-3 hours
- Proposal: Same session
- Handoff to optimizer: When ranking complete

goals.objective: Phase 3.6: Observable Claude Instrumentation (Parallel Track)
goals.description:
**Workstream 2: Phase 3.6 Observable Claude Instrumentation (Parallel Track)**

Observable Claude is the instrumentation layer that allows each Claude in the empirica mesh to measure its own epistemic state. Phase 3.6 gates on Phase 3.5 completion (observability stack). With Phase 3.5 at 2/3 complete (Jaeger + dashboards live, Loki deferred), Phase 3.6 can proceed.

**Scope:**
This phase builds agent-level instrumentation that integrates with the Phase 3.5 observability stack:
- OTEL span instrumentation for empirica lifecycle (PREFLIGHT → noetic → CHECK → praxic → POSTFLIGHT)
- Span linking to transaction_id and goal tracking
- Epistemic vector metrics (13-vector framework instrumented as OpenTelemetry GaugeMetrics)
- Trace-to-dashboard flow (Jaeger traces → Grafana correlation → per-practice dashboards)

**Deliverables:**
1. otel_instrumentation.py (core span + metric machinery)
2. epistemic_metrics.py (13-vector → metric emission)
3. CLI hooks for automatic transaction instrumentation
4. Integration tests (trace collection → Grafana visibility)
5. Deployment documentation + runbook

**Timeline:**
- Design + prototyping: 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-18 (2 weeks)
- Implementation: 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-01 (2 weeks)
- Testing + integration: 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-15 (2 weeks)
- Documentation + runbook: 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-30 (2 weeks)

**Success Criteria:**
- OTEL spans for all transaction phases (PREFLIGHT/noetic/CHECK/praxic/POSTFLIGHT) visible in Jaeger UI
- 13-vector metrics flowing into Prometheus
- Per-practice dashboards show epistemic vector trends
- CLI instrumentation hooks working (transactions auto-traced)
- Zero breaking changes to existing empirica framework

**Dependencies:**
- Phase 3.5 observability stack (Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana) live ✓
- OTEL Collector configured ✓
- Practice Specification Template approved ✓

**Related:** Phase 3.5.6 (gates on Phase 3.5 completion); Phase 3.4 + 3.5 observability infrastructure

goals.objective: Phase 3.5.6: Observable Claude - Empirica Instrumentation
goals.description:
Embed observability into empirica-foundation-evaluator seat itself. Instrument epistemic transactions to emit OpenTelemetry traces and Prometheus metrics, measure investigation latency, artifact discipline, goal completion rates. Unified observability stack: task service metrics + Claude seat metrics in one Prometheus/Grafana/AlertManager system. Implements the recursive measurement principle (turtle - measure the measurer).

**Scope:**
- Modify empirica CLI to emit structured events during PREFLIGHT/noetic/CHECK/praxic/POSTFLIGHT phases
- Instrument key gates: unknown resolution, artifact type ratio, graph density, calibration drift
- Export to Prometheus (metrics) + Jaeger (traces) via OpenTelemetry
- Dashboard showing Claude seat alongside task service metrics
- Alert rules for epistemic health (investigation stalls, type collapse, completion stalls)

**Success Criteria:**
- Real-time visibility into epistemic state during sessions
- Artifact graph health tracked continuously
- Alerts fire when investigation exceeds baseline or unknown accumulation detected
- Single pane of glass: task-service metrics + Claude seat metrics in Grafana
- Documented instrumentation patterns for other practices to adopt

**Why This Matters:**
This is the recursive application of the turtle principle (empirica-constitution §III): the system measuring practitioners gets measured the same way. Your seat as Admiral + Evaluator needs to model what observability looks like for the foundation.

**Dependencies:**
- Phase 3.4 (observability stack) must be complete and stable
- Requires OTEL integration in empirica-foundation-evaluator seat
- Parallel work possible with Phase 3.5 enhancements (Jaeger/Loki/dashboards) for task service

**Status:** Queued (post-Phase-3.4, pre-Phase-3.5-finalization)
